claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if either party discloses termination, non-renewal or waiver of the minimum purchase or minimum volume commitments, if Tower qualifies an alternative InP epiwafer supplier for the same 200Gb/lane and OCS programmes, or if IQE later restates the arrangement as non-binding.
claims.statement: On 2026-06-15 IQE plc and Tower Semiconductor jointly announced a multi-year agreement under which IQE supplies InP epiwafers to Tower for silicon photonics optical connectivity serving AI data centre infrastructure. The agreement includes a minimum purchase commitment by Tower in the first year, a reciprocal supply commitment from IQE, and minimum volume commitments thereafter. Contract value, volumes, duration and exclusivity are not disclosed.

claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Tower discloses that the 200Gb/lane programme does not reach volume production, or if the optical-circuit-switch application is dropped from the agreement scope.
claims.statement: Tower Semiconductor's disclosed application scope for the IQE InP epiwafers covers 200Gb/lane pluggable transceivers, prototyping of next-generation 400Gb/lane modulators, and optical-circuit-switches for datacentre deployment. The 400Gb/lane element is explicitly described as prototyping, not volume production.

source_doc.title: IQE and Tower Semiconductor announce multi-year InP epiwafer supply agreement

sources.quote: Multi-year agreement for the supply of Indium Phosphide (InP) epiwafers for optical connectivity solutions serving AI-driven data centre infrastructure.
The agreement provides for a minimum purchase commitment by Tower in the first year, a reciprocal supply commitment from IQE, and minimum volume commitments thereafter.

200Gbs/lane for pluggable transceivers and the prototyping of next-generation 400Gb/lane modulators, as well as other critical applications including optical-circuit-switches for deployment in datacentres.
We are pleased to partner with IQE as a key supplier for our next-generation photonic technologies.
